title: The Importance of Rifq and Mercy in the Tarbiyah of Children

text_simplified: Rifq (gentleness) and mercy are foundational in the tarbiyah of children, and parents must avoid harshness and violence. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: 'The strong one is not the one who overpowers others, but the strong one is the one who controls himself when angry.' This mercy makes it easier to guide children toward goodness and helps them accept advice.

review_defects.why: The Arabic term 'الرفق' is transliterated as 'Rifq' while the parallel term 'الرحمة' is translated as 'Mercy' rather than transliterated as 'Rahmah'. This creates an inconsistency in the treatment of Islamic terms within the same document.
